title: Pomas
summary: A Windows desktop application for poultry farm record-keeping, batch management, feed and inventory, health records, egg production, sales, expenses, and reporting.
problem: Helps poultry farmers organize bookkeeping and calculate business performance and profit.
contribution: Defined the product specifications and requirements. Other implementation contributions will be documented only when verified.
publicNotes: Showcase screenshots must hide sensitive farm, customer, and financial records.

title: ENJ0Y Shop
summary: A shop application for product browsing, search, cart management, authentication, and order checkout, with a companion Android app.
problem: Provides a shared shopping experience across web and Android.
contribution: Full-stack web application and Android client development.
publicNotes: No public web demo link is listed yet.

title: Todo List
summary: A task manager for creating, editing, completing, reopening, deleting, searching, filtering, and sorting tasks.
problem: Gives users a simple place to organize tasks and due dates.
contribution: Built as an HNG 15 Stage 1 project.
publicNotes: README describes a public no-login demo; no verified demo URL was found in the repository.

title: Relic Rush 3D
summary: A 3D endless runner with lane switching, obstacles, relic collection, scoring, and keyboard and touch controls.
problem: A browser game designed for desktop and mobile play.

title: RetailOS
summary: A retail operations platform covering product management, inventory, point-of-sale workflows, customers, low-stock alerts, and platform administration.
problem: Helps small retailers manage day-to-day store operations and keep sales and stock records organized.
contribution: Product and software development across the client, server, and administration applications.
publicNotes: The project is still in development; paid subscription activation is not yet configured.

title: APIMON
summary: A cloud-based uptime and API monitoring platform that schedules independent checks, records availability and response times, and tracks incidents.
problem: Helps operators detect website and API failures and review service reliability over time.
contribution: Product and software development across the React dashboard, Flask API direction, and Cloudflare Worker monitoring engine.
publicNotes: Phase 6 production hardening is implemented, but production deployment and its remaining acceptance criteria are not verified.

title: Pomas Website
summary: The public product website for Pomas, including product information, release downloads, and a GitHub-based feedback flow.
problem: Gives poultry businesses a public place to understand Pomas and access verified application releases.
contribution: Product website development and integration with the public Pomas release repository.
publicNotes: Release metadata and installer links are read from the Pomas desktop repository.
